concept.hook: Frame 1: a mid-air freeze — but you haven't seen the drop yet.
concept.angle: A hip-hop power-move combo with the signature move withheld until the final beat, looped invisibly.
concept.script: 0:00 hard cut into a mid-air freeze, but the signature move is held back; power moves build on the beat, then suddenly the payoff pose lands at 0:13 and loops back to frame 1.
concept.visual_prompt: A single dancer, hip-hop power moves, mid-peak motion, isolated on a solid neon-magenta background, metallic reflective outfit catching light, a hard cut or light shift roughly every 2s, 4K, no artifacts. Loop-ready.
concept.comment_bait_question: Name a song harder than this
concept.on_screen_text: You won't guess the final pose
concept.title: You won't guess the final pose #aidance #shorts
concept.description: AI dance to Bruno Mars - I Just Might. But wait for the final pose — drop the song you want next below.

score.judge_rationale: v2: strong rising-audio (13/15) and a second-person hook with a delayed payoff. The comment bait is present but overt bait is de-weighted in v2. Growing tier (84); marginal gains are in retention and audio, not more bait.
score.rationale: engagement_bait is the lowest category (6/10) but only 10% of v2; see category_breakdown.
score.recommended_fix_priority: engagement_bait is the lowest category (6/10) but only 10% of v2 — the higher-marginal levers are retention_and_loop (tighten the delayed-resolution gap, RL-04) and audio_alignment (rising sound, AA-03). Balance overt bait with organic intrigue.

harness_diff.script_prompt_change: Tighten the micro-curiosity gap (withhold the signature move to ~0:13) and prefer a rising approved sound; ease off overt comment bait.
harness_diff.rationale: Under v2 weights, retention (25%) and audio (15%) outweigh engagement bait (10%). Reinforce delayed_resolution + rising_audio rather than chasing the lowest raw category.

lesson.observation: engagement_bait was the lowest category (6/10), but under v2 it is only 10% weight; audio (13/15) and retention (21/25) carry far more of the total.
lesson.rule: Prioritize fixes by category weight x gap, not by lowest raw category. v2 rewards rising audio and delayed-resolution retention over overt comment bait.
lesson.evidence: Generation 1 (v2): total 84 -> growing; engagement_bait 6/10 (10% weight) vs retention 21/25 (25%) and audio 13/15 (15%).
lesson.harness_change: Raise delayed_resolution (+0.10) and rising_audio (+0.10); ease comment_bait_question (-0.05); tighten the micro-curiosity gap in script_prompt.
lesson.expected_effect: Total crosses 85 (viral) via retention + audio gains, not more bait; overt-bait penalty risk drops.
